phy_frame_waveform.modulation: CSS chirp per symbol; each symbol = 2^SF chips over the bandwidth.

symbol_timing.note: Higher SF / narrower bandwidth -> longer symbol -> longer time-on-air.

class_a_receive_window_timing.RX1_open: RECEIVE_DELAY1 (default 1 s) after end of uplink, same channel/DR (offset by RX1DROffset)
class_a_receive_window_timing.RX2_open: RECEIVE_DELAY2 (default 2 s) after uplink, fixed region frequency/DR (e.g. 869.525 MHz / DR0 in EU868)
class_a_receive_window_timing.rule: If a valid downlink preamble is detected in RX1, RX2 is not opened.

duty_cycle_timing: Unslotted ALOHA; regional duty-cycle limit (e.g. 1% per sub-band in EU868) bounds the fraction of time a device may transmit, enforcing an off-time proportional to the last time-on-air.
general_timing_rule: Time-on-air grows with spreading factor and shrinks with bandwidth; the receiver synchronizes on the preamble up-chirps and the sync word before demodulating the payload by de-chirp correlation.
